title: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B: Attributed Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory Writing
abstract: arXiv:2610.22196v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: External-memory systems extend language-model applications beyond a context window, but their quality depends critically on the model executing the write path: deciding what to retain, how precisely to represent it, and how new evidence should update persistent state. Existing frameworks typically place a general-purpose large language model behind framework-specific prompts. This raises serving cost, and a writer specialized for one protocol does not transfer directly to another; a unified model that can operate across established memory frameworks remains largely unexplored. We present Hy-Memory-30B-A3B, a compact long-term-memory writer trained across Mem0, MemOS, and Hy-Memory. Memory On-Policy Distillation teaches framework-specific write protocols on student-generated states; Memory RL then optimizes downstream answerability using dense per-chunk probes, attributed cross-chunk rewards, over-storage controls, and chunk-level GRPO. C

translated_title: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B：用于长期记忆写入的归因强化学习方法
translated_abstract: 外部记忆系统将语言模型的应用扩展到了上下文窗口之外，但其质量关键取决于执行写入路径的模型：决定保留什么内容、如何精确地表示这些内容，以及新证据应如何更新持久化状态。现有框架通常将通用大语言模型置于特定框架的提示词之后，这增加了服务成本，而且针对某一种协议专门优化的写入器无法直接迁移到其他协议；一个能够在多个成熟记忆框架之间通用的统一模型在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们提出了 Hy-Memory-30B-A3B，一个在 Mem0、MemOS 和 Hy-Memory 三种框架上训练的紧凑型长期记忆写入器。记忆在线策略蒸馏在学生模型生成的状态上教授特定框架的写入协议；随后记忆强化学习通过密集的分块级探测、归因化的跨分块奖励、过度存储控制以及分块级 GRPO 来优化下游问答的可回答性。
tldr: 提出了 Hy-Memory-30B-A3B，一个通过记忆在线策略蒸馏与归因强化学习在 Mem0、MemOS 和 Hy-Memory 等多种记忆框架上统一训练的紧凑型长期记忆写入模型。
en_tdlr: We present Hy-Memory-30B-A3B, a compact unified long-term memory writer trained across Mem0, MemOS, and Hy-Memory frameworks via Memory On-Policy Distillation and attributed reinforcement learning.
